local function describe(label)
    local env = getfenv(C_StoreSecure.GetProductList)
    print("STORE_METHOD_TYPES", label, type(StoreFrame.IsShown), type(StoreFrame.Show), type(StoreFrame.GetScript), type(FireEvent))
    print("STORE_LIST_ENV", label, env == _G, rawget(env, "_G") == _G, rawget(env, "StoreFrame") == StoreFrame, rawget(env, "__secureenv") == __secureenv, type(rawget(env, "FireEvent")))
    local visible, populated = 0, 0
    for _, card in ipairs(StoreFrame.ProductCards or {}) do
        if card:IsShown() then visible = visible + 1 end
        if card:GetID() > 0 then populated = populated + 1 end
    end
    print("STORE_PUBLIC_COUNTS", label, StoreFrame:IsShown(), StoreFrame:IsVisible(), visible, populated)
end
assert(StoreFrame, "original public StoreFrame required")
describe("before")
StoreFrame:Show()
describe("shown")
C_StoreSecure.GetProductList()
describe("requested")
print("STORE_PUBLIC_METHOD_ENV_COMPLETE")
